inputs.command:
set -euo pipefail
cd /opt/madworld
NAME=madworld-capacity-$$
NET=${NAME}-net
DB=${NAME}-db
API=${NAME}-api
WORKER=${NAME}-worker
cleanup() { docker rm -f "$API" "$WORKER" "$DB" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; docker network rm "$NET" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; rm -rf "/tmp/$NAME"; }
trap cleanup EXIT
mkdir -p "/tmp/$NAME"
docker network create "$NET" >/dev/null
docker run -d --name "$DB" --network "$NET" -e POSTGRES_USER=madworld -e POSTGRES_PASSWORD=madworld -e POSTGRES_DB=madworld postgres:16 >/dev/null
for i in $(seq 1 45); do docker exec "$DB" pg_isready -U madworld -d madworld >/dev/null 2>&1 && break; sleep 1; done
docker build -q -f ops/Dockerfile.backend -t "$NAME-backend" . >/tmp/$NAME/build.log
docker run --rm --network "$NET" -e MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://madworld:madworld@$DB:5432/madworld "$NAME-backend" python scripts/migrate.py >/tmp/$NAME/migrate.log
docker run -d --name "$API" --network "$NET" -e MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://madworld:madworld@$DB:5432/madworld -e MADWORLD_DB_POOL_SIZE=10 -e MADWORLD_DB_MAX_OVERFLOW=20 -e MADWORLD_RATE_LIMIT=120 -e MADWORLD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO "$NAME-backend" uvicorn app.main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8000 >/tmp/$NAME/api-start.log
docker run -d --name "$WORKER" --network "$NET" -e MADWORLD_DATABASE_URL=postgresql://madworld:madworld@$DB:5432/madworld -e MADWORLD_WORLD_TICK_SECONDS=60 -e MADWORLD_LOG_LEVEL=INFO "$NAME-backend" python -m scripts.world_tick_worker >/tmp/$NAME/worker-start.log
for i in $(seq 1 45); do curl -fsS --max-time 2 http://$API:8000/health/ready >/tmp/$NAME/ready.out 2>/dev/null && break; sleep 1; done
START=$(date +%s)
END=$((START+30))
: > /tmp/$NAME/times.log
: > /tmp/$NAME/errors.log
while [ $(date +%s) -lt $END ]; do for c in $(seq 1 20); do (T0=$(date +%s%N); if curl -fsS --max-time 3 -o /dev/null http://$API:8000/health/ready; then T1=$(date +%s%N); echo $((T1-T0)) >> /tmp/$NAME/times.log; else echo error >> /tmp/$NAME/errors.log; fi) & done; wait; done
python3 - "$NAME" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys,statistics,json,subprocess,time
name=sys.argv[1]
times=[int(x)/1e6 for x in pathlib.Path(f'/tmp/{name}/times.log').read_text().splitlines() if x.strip()]
errors=len(pathlib.Path(f'/tmp/{name}/errors.log').read_text().splitlines()) if pathlib.Path(f'/tmp/{name}/errors.log').exists() else 0
total=len(times)+errors
def pct(p):
    if not times:return None
    a=sorted(times); k=(len(a)-1)*p/100; f=int(k); c=min(f+1,len(a)-1); return round(a[f]+(a[c]-a[f])*(k-f),3)
print('CAPACITY_WORKLOAD=GET /health/ready, 20 concurrent clients, 30s bounded read-only')
print(f'CAPACITY_REQUESTS={total}')
print(f'CAPACITY_SUCCESS={len(times)}')
print(f'CAPACITY_ERRORS={errors}')
print(f'CAPACITY_RPS={total/30:.3f}')
print(f'LATENCY_P50_MS={pct(50)}')
print(f'LATENCY_P95_MS={pct(95)}')
print(f'LATENCY_P99_MS={pct(99)}')
print(f'ERROR_RATE={errors/total if total else 1:.6f}')
PY
printf '--- DB CONNECTIONS ---\n'
docker exec "$DB" psql -U madworld -d madworld -tAc 'select count(*) from pg_stat_activity;'
printf '--- API STATS ---\n'
docker stats --no-stream --format 'api={{.CPUPerc}} mem={{.MemUsage}}' "$API"
printf 'worker={{$(docker stats --no-stream --format \'{{.CPUPerc}} mem={{.MemUsage}}\' "$WORKER")}}'
printf '--- HEALTH ---\n'
cat /tmp/$NAME/ready.out
printf '--- WORKER LOG TAIL ---\n'
docker logs --tail 30 "$WORKER" 2>&1 || true
printf 'CAPACITY_ENVIRONMENT=isolated_postgres16_api_worker_containers\n'
printf 'PRODUCTION_DATABASE_TOUCHED=false\n'
